verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe Auto Drafts and Email Assistant attaching a ready-to-send draft to every email that needs a reply, written in the user's voice. The AI matches voice and tone learned from already-sent emails, adapts style per recipient, can be tuned with plain-language writing instructions, and leaves drafts for the user to edit and send. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts actually sound like the user rather than generic boilerplate (all evidence is vendor-claimed).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone in the emails you've already sent
Every message that needs a reply comes with a draft written in your voice.
Every draft matches your voice and tone, using your unique style for each person.
with Auto Drafts 2.0, every message that needs a reply comes with a draft. You can just edit and send.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
